task: Draft a two-sentence newsletter excerpt for a fictional hospital's internal staff bulletin summarising the results of a completed handwashing audit. Attribute findings to the audit report; do not add regulatory penalties, infection rates, or compliance conclusions not supplied.

facts.text: Northgate Hospital conducted a handwashing compliance audit across three wards in April 2025.
The audit report found that observed compliance varied by ward and by shift.
A follow-up training session is scheduled for 15 May 2025.
The audit report's specific compliance percentages are confidential and are not reproduced in the bulletin.

forbidden_additions: Specific compliance percentages or ward names.
A regulatory penalty or enforcement action.
An infection-rate claim linked to compliance levels.
preserve: The April 2025 audit context and the attribution of findings to the audit report.
The ward-and-shift variability observation without specific figures.
